activeSlice.scope: Add shadow-only Hunter Trend Intelligence: deterministic story clustering, cross-source corroboration, freshness, velocity/acceleration, creator/category outlier features, trend stage/confidence and diagnostics. Existing Hunter ranking/persistence remains authoritative.
successCriteria: Shadow clustering groups semantically/lexically equivalent signals without persisting or ranking production opportunities.
Cross-source, cross-platform and independent-publisher corroboration are measured deterministically.
Velocity, acceleration and creator/category outlier features use only supplied observable metrics; unavailable metrics are explicitly marked unknown.
Trend stage, saturation, freshness and evidence confidence are deterministic and versioned.
Diagnostics report cluster counts, corroboration, stage distribution and missing-feature rates.
No provider credentials, scheduled execution, production Hunter wiring, UI changes or production enablement are introduced.
PES v2 CI and Security baseline pass before certification.
